description: Toggle drone favorite status in devices panel on desktop: The star button for the selected drone successfully changes its appearance to indicate a favorited state (such as filled or highlighted), and remains in that state.

Remove drone from favorites by clicking star again on desktop: The star button returns to its unfavorited appearance (such as outlined or unhighlighted), confirming the toggle functionality works in both directions.
Toggle drone favorite status on mobile viewport: The star button changes to the favorited state correctly on the mobile layout without overlapping or touch-target issues.
Favorite multiple independent drones: Both drones show independent favorited states without affecting each other or causing unintended toggles elsewhere in the list.
Verify Mute Alerts toggle is present and disabled by default: The Mute Alerts toggle should be visible and in the disabled (off) state by default.
Verify enabling Mute Alerts suppresses incoming alert banners: Incoming alert banners are suppressed and do not appear on the screen when Mute Alerts is enabled.
Verify muted alerts do not appear in the alerts panel: The alerts panel remains clear of any alerts that arrived while the Mute Alerts toggle was active.
Verify disabling Mute Alerts resumes normal alert display: Incoming alert banners and panel entries are once again displayed normally after disabling the Mute Alerts toggle.
